svg.title: Faithful actual coefficients and finite solution transport
svg.desc: Faithful scalar extension, actual finite resolution comparison maps and both homotopies give a localized solution equivalence using one canonical ring and its strict cutoff. An exact contact shear x prime=x+z, t prime=t-z squared over two, z prime=z changes the point conormal's base projection to a parabola. The real slice plotted is z between minus one and one. A separate contact solution comparison is still required.
svg.text: Faithful coefficients and finite solution transport
Actual analytic operators · finite chain identities · a strict localized cutoff
1. Retain the actual coefficient rings
D → E → B = E∞
E is right D-flat; B is faithfully right E-flat on every left module.
M → B ⊗E M is injective; B ⊗D − is exact.
The ring B has one domain, every-ε positive heads and factorial negative tails.
An actual isomorphism B ⊗D N ≅ B ⊗D N′ gives finite comparison data.
A formal or entire-symbol inverse outside those bounds cannot replace B.
Faithfulness and exact actual resolutions: HGT.4–HGT.10.
2. Keep both maps and both homotopies
f: PB → QB, g: QB → PB
gf − I = dP H + H dP; fg − I = dQ K + K dQ.
All entries, products and zero witnesses fit in one actual canonical ring R.
The strict R-module G has its D0-linear localized denominator G ≃ O.
Finite Hom retains each homotopy: SH(φ) = (−1)ᑫ φH.
Therefore Sol(N) ≃ Sol(N′) at p, in the stated base coordinates.
No extra flatness of R over D0 or resolution over D0 is required.
Actual finite construction, ring witnesses, cutoff and signs: HGT.11–HGT.18.
3. The contact step changes the base projection
x′
t′
Original base image: one point. Sheared front: t′ = −(x′)²/2.
dt′ + z′ dx′ = dt + z dx
The shear is contact; it is not a cotangent lift of a base biholomorphism.
The ordinary time shift t″ = t′ + (x′)²/2 makes the branch standard.
A general contact solution comparison is still required. HGT.28–HGT.30.
